## Scope & Stopping Criterion (for Humans and AI Agents)

**In scope (Mini Program-specific contracts):**
- Mini Program-specific framework semantics (App/Page/Component lifecycles, setData snapshots, observers, behaviors, relations, slots, pureDataPattern, virtualHost, styleIsolation).
- WXML/WXSS/WXS language and dual-thread bridge contracts (templates, keyed/positional list reuse, model: two-way bindings, mark:, mut-bind:, WXS state and change:prop/ownerInstance).
- Mini Program routing, page stack, EventChannel, CommonJS module loader and subpackage async loading (require.async, componentPlaceholder).
- Mini Program rendering/query/canvas bridge APIs (built-in component catalog & visual refs, SelectorQuery, animate/clearAnimation, page-meta/page-container, Canvas 2D bridge).
- Core deterministic wx.* APIs (Promise contract, Storage, FileSystemManager, FileDescriptor, Base64, Worker, Clipboard, System/Device info, HTTP/WebSocket fixture contracts).

**Out of scope (do not pad test counts with these):**
- Generic Web/DOM/HTML5 Canvas drawing minutiae already covered by Web Platform Tests (WPT) where Mini Program engines delegate directly to WebView/Skia (e.g., exhaustive Canvas path join/miter/bezier permutations).
- WeChat-proprietary commercial or social ecosystem services (WeChat Pay, Ads, Channels/Finder, VoIP, Live Pusher/Player, Store, Share-to-WeChat).
- Hardware-dependent sensors/radios and OS permission dialogs that cannot be deterministically verified in simulator CI (tracked separately under device/hosted/interactive profiles).

**Clause completion rule:** A clause is marked 'covered' only when its primary behavior, key edge cases, and failure/isolation contracts are verified by committed cases in fixtures/reference.js with gaps = []. Otherwise it is 'partial' (with explicit remaining gaps) or 'missing'.

<a id="app-runtime"></a>
### App Lifecycle, Errors & Global Runtime

| ID | Priority | Status | Clause & Contract | Mapped Cases | Remaining Gaps |
| --- | :---: | :---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| `APP-01` | P0 | `COVERED` | **App singleton identity & launch lifecycle ordering** — getApp() returns the same singleton across pages; App.onLaunch runs before App.onShow and before the entry page's onLoad with an empty getCurrentPages() stack during onLaunch. | 4 (`app.instance`, `app.launch-order`, `app.launch-pages-empty`, `app.identity-across-pages`) | — |
| `APP-02` | P1 | `COVERED` | **Launch & enter options shape and foreground stability** — App launch/enter options expose path, query, referrerInfo and numeric scene; in-app page navigation does not fire spurious wx.onAppShow/onAppHide or onPageNotFound. | 6 (`app.launch-options-shape`, `app.enter-options-path`, `app.foreground-stable-during-navigation`, `app.page-not-found-not-fired`, …) | — |
| `APP-03` | P0 | `COVERED` | **Error propagation, App/wx error hooks & recovery** — Runtime errors in observers, event handlers, detached lifetimes and API callbacks reach wx.onError, App.onError and component error lifetimes without breaking subsequent bubbling, complete callbacks, detachment or updates; console.error does not trigger onError; unhandled promise rejections reach wx.onUnhandledRejection and App.onUnhandledRejection. | 9 (`error.observer-recovers`, `error.event-handler-continues`, `error.detached-recovers`, `error.api-callback-complete`, …) | — |
| `APP-04` | P1 | `PARTIAL` | **App.onPageNotFound real trigger & recovery** — Navigating or launching to a non-existent route triggers onPageNotFound / wx.onPageNotFound with { path, query, isEntryPage } without corrupting the current page stack. | 1 (`route.page-not-found-in-app-isolation`) | Cold-start onPageNotFound entry recovery is verified separately via tools/devtools/check-page-not-found.cjs (since wx.restartMiniProgram destroys the running suite page context). |
